title: Without See Financial Data no dollar amounts show in Tech or Board View
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 1 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Esther Howard") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. A second user "Nate Nofinance" whose role has Work Orders view and, for now, See Financial Data (custom role under Settings > Roles & Permissions), signed in in a second browser.
  6. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  7. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to "Esther Howard".
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.
    • As Nate Nofinance, turn Total price on in Tech View's column chooser and in Board View's Fields to display.
custom_steps:
1. As the admin, edit Nate Nofinance's role and turn See Financial Data off, then save.
  2. As Nate Nofinance sign in again, open Work Orders, pick Tech View and search for the case customer.
  3. Read the columns and open the column chooser.
  4. Open every filter in the toolbar and read its options.
  5. Pick Board View, read the card and open Fields to display.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Tech View has no Total price column and its column chooser does not offer it; Board View cards show no dollar amount and Fields to display does not offer total price.
  • No filter offers a dollar-amount option, and Nate's earlier saved choice (Total price on) does not bring any dollar value back. List is not part of this change and stays as in production.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display (Board View) and columns (Tech View)); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S5-E2, S5-E6, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions MF-1 (see financial data; List dropped from this answer, DR-33). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-E2: “Without see financial data permission, hide all dollar-amount fields from displays, filters, and field/column pickers.”
  • S5-E6: “Saved filters and field selections must not reveal financial values when see financial data is off.”
